correctness.rationale: Write Xi=epsilon_i Yi with independent fair signs and iid positive magnitudes, fix sign sum h and use Q=T−S²/n. Conditional cumulants of S (ah,nv,hr,nw) and Cov(T,S²)=n(f−b²)+2(h²−n)a(c−ab) yield affine dependence on h². Total-variance closure fixes intercept V−A+Bn with V=(n−1)/n[(n−1)f−(n−3)b²], A=2a⁴(n−1)/n. B=(4a/n²)[(n−2)E(Y(Y−a)²)+Cov(Y²,Y)], and independent-copy identity Cov(Y²,Y)=1/2 E[(Y−Yprime)²(Y+Yprime)] ensures strict positivity unless Y constant. K binomial fair gives Var(h²)=2n(n−1), so explained fraction=2a⁴/[(n−1)f−(n−3)b²]. Independently exact-enumerated conditional means and variances for n2..5 under a two-atom positive-magnitude law; inspected all checker.py enumeration and the full analytic proof. Checks finite only; derivation is all-n.

Exact distribution-uniform conditional dispersion monotonicity, limiting constant-magnitude equality, and Gaussian explained fraction 4/(π²n) clarify a natural statistical question about sign information and scale. This is an all-n structural statement rather than a generic unconditioned variance computation.
